/*
 * Macro used to grow the current buffer.
 */
#define growBuffer(buffer) {                                            \
    xmlChar *tmp;                                                       \
    buffer##_size *= 2;                                                 \
    tmp = (xmlChar *) xmlRealloc(buffer, buffer##_size);                \
    if (tmp == NULL) {                                                  \
        htmlErrMemory(ctxt, "growing buffer\n");                        \
        xmlFree(buffer);                                                \
        return(NULL);                                                   \
    }                                                                   \
    buffer = tmp;                                                       \
}
